reviews.title: What happened
reviews.text: They don’t have the good app in the App Store. I payed $29.00 for the old app…rip off. Retro daydreams was my favorite for old photos.
I opened the app that I use every day for my spiritual site and most of the features I use are now gone. Erasing certain things removing backgrounds even all of my work I’ve already done is gone.
